isolation.head: d835bc9e
isolation.notes: INTERNAL_COMMAND_TOKEN read from apps/app/.env into a shell variable and never printed (redacted as <internal-token> in evidence). No flags changed, no service start/stop, no browser session, no git writes; tenant-api 3009 untouched. git status was clean before and after the test runs (no env.ts regeneration noise).

assertions.observed: Negative first: `curl -si "http://localhost:3001/resources/reservations/context?orgId=t58bgatqh3rv0s3movrecyj1"` with no Authorization -> HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden, content-type: application/json, body {"error":"Forbidden"} (the loader in `apps/app/app/routes/resources+/reservations.context.ts` awaits `requireInternalCommandAuth` first and rewrites the unauthenticated 302 to 403). A garbage Bearer token also returned 403. Authenticated: `Authorization: Bearer <internal-token>` -> HTTP/1.1 200 OK, `cache-control: private, no-store`, content-type: application/json, 2526-byte payload with exactly the `reservationsContextSchema` keys (`packages/reservations/src/schemas/internal.ts:80-93`, z.strictObject, and the route itself runs `reservationsContextSchema.parse`): orgId, dataRegion:"us", folded features{enabled,online,waitlist,payments,experiences,voice}=true, organization{name,slug,defaultLocale,locales,siteOrigin,sitePublished,emailTheme,logoUrl}, locations[2] (both isActive:true) each with timeZone/currency (America/New_York + USD, America/New_York + CAD), payments{processor:null,deposit:false,guarantee:false,platformFeeBp:0}, staffing{enabled:true}, voice{enabled:true}. emailTheme: 10 color fields, all 6-digit hex (#rrggbb), zero oklch()/rgb()/hsl() occurrences. PII scan of the payload: zero guest-PII keys anywhere (no guest/name/notes/allergy/tag keys); the only phone/email-shaped values are the two OrganizationLocation business phones, which are part of `reservationsContextLocationSchema` (internal.ts:49-59) - no guest rows. Cache source facts (`apps/tenant-api/src/lib/reservations-context.ts`): RESERVATIONS_CONTEXT_FRESH_TTL_MS = 5*60*1000 (300_000), STALE_TTL_MS = 24h (86_400_000), FAILURE_COOLDOWN_MS = 30s (30_000); fetch uses `redirect: 'error'` and `AbortSignal.timeout(3_000)` with the internal Bearer header; `invalidateReservationsContext(orgId)` deletes the entry; `POST /internal/reservations/context-changed` (`apps/tenant-api/src/routes/reservations-internal.ts:69`) requires internal auth (401 otherwise), verifies active+provisioned+region match (404/403), then invalidates. Fresh test runs (exit 0 each): (1) `cd apps/tenant-api && CI=true npx vitest run src/lib/reservations-context.test.ts` -> 1 file / 3 tests passed, asserting the exact TTL constants, `redirect:'error'` + Bearer header, no refetch within the 5-min fresh window, 24h stale serving with the 30s failure cooldown, and 'invalidates immediately when invalidateReservationsContext is called' (next get refetches); (2) `cd apps/tenant-api && CI=true npx vitest run src/routes/reservations-security.test.ts` -> 13 tests passed, including 'POST /internal/reservations/context-changed invalidates the org cache with valid INTERNAL_COMMAND_TOKEN' (fetch spy: 1 call, still 1 while cached, POST -> 200, next getReservationsContext -> 2 calls). Live exercise: POST /internal/reservations/context-changed with the token -> HTTP/1.1 200 OK, cache-control: private, no-store, body {"ok":true,"orgId":"t58bgatqh3rv0s3movrecyj1"}; the public consumer `GET /reservations/config` (Origin: http://acme.menuza.test:3008 -> resolvePublicOrg -> getReservationsContext) returned 200 throughout: 3.5-5.0 ms while the cache was fresh and 55.3 ms immediately after the POST (consistent with an upstream re-fetch; the body is unchanged by design).
assertions.limitations: Cache eviction cannot be observed directly over the live HTTP surface: neither the App dev server nor tenant-api logs the outbound context fetch, and a re-fetch returns identical content, so the live timing pattern is corroborating only; the eviction proof is the freshly re-executed fetch-spy tests (unit immediate-invalidation case and the security-test context-changed case). The 3-second timeout is confirmed from source (`AbortSignal.timeout(3_000)` in reservations-context.ts:50); the unit test's fetch assertion uses objectContaining and does not itself assert the signal.

assertions.observed: Fresh runs, both exit 0, 0 failures: (1) `cd apps/tenant-api && CI=true npx vitest run src/routes/reservations-security.test.ts` -> 1 file / 13 tests passed. The sweep dynamically enumerates every mounted operator route from `app.routes` (deduped method+path) in `buildOperatorApp()`; runtime re-check with tsx printed exactly 10 routes: GET /setup/overview, POST /setup/locations/:locationId/settings, GET /experiences, GET /book/day, POST /book/reservations, GET /waitlist, GET /guests, POST /guests, GET /reports/summary, POST /payments/refund (6 GET + 4 POST; discovery assertion requires >=8; writeRoutes assertion requires >=4, actual 4). Quoted assertions executed per route: 'refuses every route with no token (401)' (all 10 -> 401); 'refuses a token signed with wrong secret, wrong audience (tenant-api-staffing or tenant-api-operator), wrong typ, or over-long TTL (401)' (wrong secret, both wrong audiences, typ 'JWT', 901s standard TTL, 301s impersonated TTL, 301s sensitive-grant TTL - all 401 on all 10); 'refuses a token with region mismatch (403 region_mismatch)'; 'refuses a signed token with no grants in every scope (403)' (grants:[] across every scope); 'refuses a token with the wrong scope on every route (403)'; 'refuses an impersonated token on every write route (403 impersonated_read_only)'; 'refuses an active but unprovisioned organization (hasProvisionedDb = false) with uniform 404 across every route' (404 + error not_found on all 10); 'sweeps every mounted route for cross-org (ORG_B) and excluded locationIds ([LOC_2]) and never returns 5xx' (ORG_A token with ?orgId=ORG_B + X-Org-Id header -> 403/404 on all 10 and never >=500; token scoped to [LOC_2] requesting LOC_1 -> 403/404 on all 10 and never >=500; plus data-level checks: ORG_A guests response has orgId ORG_A and never contains the ORG_B-only guest, and a LOC_1-scoped setup overview returns exactly [LOC_1]). Other tests in the same file: 'app.ts mounts all reservations operator, public, internal, tick, and voice routers'; 'internal and voice routes refuse bare requests with 401' (context-changed, /api/reservations/tick, /api/voice/actions/reservation-availability); context-changed cache invalidation (see VAL-FND-018); 'RESERVATIONS_PUBLIC_ENABLED=false kill switch answers 503 on /reservations/*'. (2) `cd apps/app && CI=true npx vitest run app/utils/reservations/reservations-guards.test.ts` -> 1 file / 24 tests passed. Coverage from source: all 10 files under `routes/_app+/$orgSlug_+/reservations+` (10 exported loaders, 0 actions); per file it asserts requireReservationsAccess is the guard and that the first `await` in the function body is the guard call, that nothing before the guard matches request.formData/json/text or `db`, and that no unguarded data function exists (entry points are only loader/action - no clientLoader/clientAction anywhere); plus the _layout.tsx location-picker guard (locations.length > 1) and the resources side: `resources+/reservations.context.ts` loader must call requireInternalCommandAuth (or requireUserWithOrganizationPermission on reservations.region-summary.ts, which does not exist yet) before any db/fetch. Test composition 1 finds + 10 loader-guard + 10 no-unguarded-data-function + 1 layout + 1 finds-resources + 1 resource-auth = 24.
assertions.limitations: The exhaustive 401/403 per-route matrix applies to the 10 enumerated operator routes. The 2 public /reservations/* routes (GET /config, POST /holds) are Origin-bound and never accept operator tokens; in the same file they are covered by the app.ts mount-presence assertion and the RESERVATIONS_PUBLIC_ENABLED=false -> 503 test, not by the per-route token matrix. Only `resources+/reservations.context.ts` exists at foundation (no reservations.region-summary.ts yet).

frictions.description: Live observation of the tenant-api per-org context cache invalidation over HTTP is not possible: the App dev server (workerd) does not log the outbound GET /resources/reservations/context, tenant-api logs no context-fetch line, and the re-fetched config payload is identical by design - so only response timing (3.5-5.0 ms cache hits vs 55.3 ms right after POST /internal/reservations/context-changed) hints at eviction.
frictions.resolution: Proved eviction with the freshly re-executed fetch-spy tests (unit immediate-invalidation case; security-test context-changed case counts fetch 1 -> 1 -> 2) and exercised the live POST (200 {"ok":true,"orgId":...}); reported the live timing as corroborating only.
